textContent.value: Only new signed hosts (Since 1st October 2025 onwards) can participate this event, hosts can earn points through gift receipts, live streaming duration, live room shares, new followers and New Fans Group Memeber:
1.Gift Receipts: Each bean received = 1 point, with no limit.
2.Live Streaming Duration: Every 100 minutes of live streaming = 10 point, with Limits of 100 points.
3.Live Room Shares: Every 10 shares of the live room = 1 point, with no limits of 100 points.
4.New Followers: Each new follower = 1 point, with a maximum of 100 points.
1 new Fans Group Memember=10 Points with a limitation of 200 points.
